$comment: The components and hooks of this package the React Compiler leaves uncompiled: its bailouts (it could not prove the Rules of React; the reason is its own) and the functions it cannot see as components (notCompiled). Written by tooling/js/react-compiler-coverage.mjs --write; CI fails on a new one, and the lists only get shorter (apps/editor/docs/adr/229-react-compiler.md).

bailouts.detail: Hooks must always be called in a consistent order, and may not be called conditionally. See the Rules of Hooks (https://react.dev/warnings/invalid-hook-call-warning)
